DESIGN DOC: (for D2/T150) Separator: 1 px of --line; vertical separators are aria-orientation aware and stretch to the row, horizontal separators are fixed height. Numbers that change while visible ask for tabular figures; the system Futura ignores font-variant-numeric, so counters stay proportional by measurement (18.719 vs 22.219 px for 111 vs 888) until the owner chooses a fallback font. Icon buttons carry a hit-area extension to at least 24 x 24 px without changing their visual size. Icons align by ink: at the current type scale every measured toolbar icon sits within 0.33 px of its button centre, so the --optical-x/--optical-y hook exists but no icon needs a value; re-measure if icons or sizes change.
